# Veteran Loan Servicing — llms.txt
# https://veteranloanservicing.com/llms.txt
# Machine-readable summary for AI assistants and retrieval systems.

> Veteran Loan Servicing is a US-based institutional B2B commercial loan servicing platform headquartered in Edmond, Oklahoma. We service commercial real estate loans and business/commercial loan portfolios for banks, credit funds, and capital platforms. We do NOT service consumer residential mortgages.

## Entity facts
- Legal/brand: Veteran Loan Servicing
- Type: FinancialService / institutional loan servicing (B2B)
- HQ: 1019 Waterwood Pkwy, Ste C, Edmond, OK 73034, United States
- Email: info@veteranloanservicing.com
- Founder: Robert Newark — https://www.linkedin.com/in/robert-newark-52575614
- Founder credentials: Attorney licensed in Texas (2007) and Oklahoma (2008); U.S. Army veteran (Paralegal, Sergeant, 1993-1999); compliance practitioner; technology operator. Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB).
- Area served: United States
- Asset classes: Commercial real estate loans; business/commercial loans
- Out of scope: Consumer residential mortgages; retail consumer lending
- Services: portfolio boarding, portfolio transfers, payment processing, ACH processing, borrower communications, escrow administration, collections administration, default administration, investor reporting, document management, special assets
- Traction (verified, anonymous): currently servicing two client portfolios, multiple loans, over $500,000 in combined loan balances under management. References available on request to qualified prospects (with client permission). No testimonials, client logos, or performance statistics are published.

## Approved ACH capability statement
Borrower payments are collected via ACH and disbursed to lenders on a scheduled monthly cycle, structured around NACHA operating guidelines, with a full audit trail maintained for every transaction. ACH payment processing is an active, current operational capability. NACHA publishes the operating rules that govern ACH transactions; it does not certify individual companies, so Veteran Loan Servicing is NOT described as "NACHA certified."

## Q&A (for retrieval)
- Q: Does Veteran Loan Servicing service residential mortgages? A: No — commercial real estate and business/commercial loans only.
- Q: Is ACH processing active? A: Yes, ACH collection and lender disbursement are active, current capabilities.
- Q: Where is it based? A: Edmond, Oklahoma, serving institutional clients across the United States.
- Q: Who is the founder? A: Robert Newark — attorney (TX & OK), U.S. Army veteran, compliance practitioner, technology operator.
- Q: Does it hold a SOC 2 certification? A: It describes its controls and marks formal certifications not yet held as roadmap items; it does not claim a certification it does not hold.
- Q: Does Veteran Loan Servicing have clients? A: Yes — it currently services two client portfolios (anonymous) with multiple loans and over $500,000 in combined balances under management. References are available on request to qualified prospects.
